AutoSizeAxes

Controls which osu.Framework.Graphics.Axes are automatically sized w.r.t. the bounds of the vertices. It is not allowed to manually set osu.Framework.Graphics.Lines.Path.Size (or osu.Framework.Graphics.Lines.Path.Width / osu.Framework.Graphics.Lines.Path.Height) on any osu.Framework.Graphics.Axes which are automatically sized.

RelativeSizeAxes

Controls which osu.Framework.Graphics.Axes are relative sizes w.r.t. osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Parent's size (from 0 to 1) in the osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Parent's coordinate system, rather than absolute sizes. The osu.Framework.Graphics.Axes set in this property are ignored by automatically sizing parents.

public override Axes RelativeSizeAxes { get; set; }

Property Value

Axes

Remarks

If an axis becomes relatively sized and its component of osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Size was previously 0, then it automatically becomes 1. In all other cases osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Size is converted such that osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.DrawSize remains invariant across changes of this property.

Size

Size of this Drawable in the osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Parent's coordinate system. May be in absolute or relative units (controlled by osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.RelativeSizeAxes).
